military.unit: the Vyova shore companies, 300 crossbows, and 160 debt-rowers on the toll galley Grey Pike
military.ties: Every debtor sentenced to row the Channel-Master's toll galleys passes through the Ledovan court at Vyova, and the Ledovans choose which bench he sits on.

FX25-106.power: The market town of Vyova on the channel, its debt court, and the rolls of men sentenced to row the toll galleys.
FX25-106.history: Bratislav Ledovan captained a galley off Beaconstone in 1008, and in 1011 the first Channel-Master made him lord of Vyova to keep the shore between the toll forts. The Ledovans hold the debt court there: under the Code of Radoslav a debtor may be sentenced to row the toll galleys, and a few hundred each season go to the benches from the Ledovan rolls. The present lord found long ago that a man with thirty sables can buy his pardon and a poorer man can take his place. In October 1104 the Channel-Master asked for 'quiet men' for a special crew, and the baron's son chose them from the second roll.
FX25-106.reputation: Harsh shore lords who sell justice by the pelt.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of Vyova
members.note: He sells pardons from the rowing bench for 30 sables a head and fills the benches with men too poor to pay.

members.role: His wife; keeper of the two rolls
members.note: She keeps two debt rolls, the true one and the one the Channel-Master sees.

members.role: Heir; captain of the toll galley Grey Pike
members.note: Radek Volan sent him in October to choose quiet men for a special crew, and he chose them without asking what for.

members.role: Daughter
members.note: She has fallen for a debt-rower on the Grey Pike and slips him bread when the galley is beached.

famousDead: Captained a galley off Beaconstone in 1008 and was made lord of Vyova.
FX25-106.secret: The Ledovans sell debtors their pardons and fill the rowing benches with poorer men, and the quiet men chosen for the Channel-Master's raft crews came from that false roll.
hooks: A rower's daughter comes to Vyova to buy her father off a raft crew.
Jelena helps her rower escape the Grey Pike.
Radek Volan learns there is a second roll.

FX25-107.name: House Krovan
FX25-107.title: Banneret of Velany
FX25-107.arms: a black boar on tawny, under a green bough

military.office: Bench knights on the service rota
military.unit: the Krovan banner, 20 lances and 200 war-hearth spears
military.ties: Krovan lances ride their forty days on the rota every year and not one day more, which the Lord Marshal has noticed.

FX25-107.power: Forest manors in Velany with tar kilns, flax and wax, and a seat beside Mirek Tolmir in the Purse Bench.
FX25-107.history: After the Black Cough emptied the Velany villages, Gorislav Krovan cleared the forest with new settlers and won his banner in 943. The Krovans burn tar, grow flax and send wax down the Tolek, so they want the river open and the Lakeland at peace; two Krovans died at Kraina in 1034 in a war the house had argued against. They sit with the Purse Bench and want the money to Andros stopped. In October 1104 the Sevany arsenal bought 200 barrels of Krovan tar and paid in toll-chest silver. In December the banneret's daughter worked out what 200 barrels of tar and eight old hulls add up to.
FX25-107.reputation: Thrifty, sensible forest lords who would rather sell than fight.

members.role: Head of the house; Banneret of Velany
members.note: He was paid for the tar in toll-chest silver, which he had never been paid in before, and keeps the coins in a separate bag.

members.role: Heir; mistress of the tar kilns
members.note: She knows what the tar was for and wants to tell the Lord Treasurer before someone tells the Lamp Party.

members.role: Son; Bench knight on the rota
members.note: He dreams of riding with the Ostec Lances instead of counting days on the rota.

members.role: Younger daughter
members.note: She is promised to a Tolmir cousin and writes in secret to a Drevnan wax factor's son she met at the Koritsa fair.

famousDead: Cleared the Velany forest after the Black Cough and won the banner in 943.
FX25-107.secret: The pitch for the Channel-Master's fire rafts was boiled from Krovan tar, and a banneret of the Purse Bench has unknowingly helped pay for a war.
hooks: Vlasta rides to Koritsa to tell Mirek Tolmir what the tar was for.
The Sevany arsenal orders 200 more barrels.
Hana's Drevnan letters are opened by the Keeper of the Seal's couriers.

FX25-108.name: House Morozan
FX25-108.title: Lord of Droin
FX25-108.arms: a silver herring on teal, above a black burned tower

military.office: Captains of the Droin shore watch
military.unit: the Droin watch, 200 crossbows and four armed herring boats
military.ties: Morozan boats carry the channel squadron's salt fish and watch the north shore, and Morozan sons row in the Channel-Master's galleys before they inherit.

FX25-108.power: The fishing town of Droin, its salt pans and herring smokehouses, and a seat at the Channel-Master's table.
FX25-108.history: The Morozans were herring-masters of Sevina, and most of the sixty fishing boats Greyhaven burned there in February 1009 were theirs. Stoyan Morozan swam ashore from the burning harbor and was the only grown man of his house to live. King Bogdan made him lord of Droin up the coast in 1010, and since then every Morozan child is taken to the burned stones of Sevina at twelve, beside the Volan heirs, and told who burned them. The house salts herring for the squadron and boils salt in the Droin pans. Its present lord has never sold a fish to a Greyhaven ship; his younger son sells them salt every new moon.
FX25-108.reputation: Grim, salt-cured shore lords who remember 1009 as if it were last winter.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of Droin
members.note: He says the Sevina prayer for the dead every dawn and has never sold a herring to Greyhaven.

members.role: Heir; mistress of the salt pans
members.note: She wants peace with Greyhaven, because a war would burn Droin as surely as it burned Sevina.

members.role: Younger son; the family's black sheep
members.note: He meets Greyhaven toll-runners off Droin at night and sells them salt for silver his father would drown him for.

members.role: Velimir's mother
members.note: She nursed old Stoyan until he died raving about Greyhaven galleys, and she still lights a candle for the Sevina dead.

famousDead: Swam out of the burning harbor of Sevina in 1009 and was made lord of Droin.
FX25-108.secret: Vladek Morozan trades salt with Greyhaven toll-runners off Droin and has told one of them, for a purse, about the hulls below Mount Dobava.
hooks: Vladek's buyer turns out to be the Greyhaven Admiral's man.
Lord Velimir takes his grandson to the Sevina stones and is followed.
Zdenka argues for peace at the Channel-Master's table.

FX25-109.name: House Gorazdin
FX25-109.title: Lord of the Yarnik Pits
FX25-109.arms: a black pick-hammer on yellow, under a red chief
FX25-109.power: Stewardship of the Yarnik and Yasov sulfur pits for House Belak, eight villages of diggers, and the pilgrims' hostel below Redcrown.
FX25-109.history: Dragoslav Gorazdin was the first steward of the Yarnik sulfur pits under Lord Dragan Belak, and in 790 the Belaks made his line barons to keep the pits for them. For three centuries the Gorazdins have dug sulfur on the slopes of Redcrown and housed the pilgrims who come each August to watch its glow. In September 1104 a rockfall flooded the best pit at Yasov and drowned thirty diggers. Vera Belak sent the Channel-Master only a third of the sulfur she had promised and needs someone to blame for the rest. The Gorazdins know the flood came from timbering skimped to rush that very order, and that the order came from Belansk.
FX25-109.reputation: Sooty, hard-working pit lords whom Belansk treats as servants with titles.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of Yarnik
members.note: He told the Keeper of the Seal that the flood was the Light's will, and he keeps the timbering accounts that say otherwise.

members.role: Heir
members.note: She dug survivors out of the Yasov flood with her own hands and wants the dead diggers' widows paid their sixty sables.

members.role: Younger son
members.note: He blames Vera Belak for the flood and has said so in a Belansk tavern, which in Belansk is never wise.

members.role: Dalibor's wife; keeper of the pilgrims' hostel
members.note: She runs the hostel below Redcrown each August and hears everything the pilgrims say.

famousDead: First steward of the Yarnik pits under Dragan Belak.
FX25-109.secret: The Yasov pit flooded because the Gorazdins skimped on timbering to rush the Channel-Master's sulfur, and Lord Dalibor keeps the accounts that prove the order came from Belansk.
hooks: Vera Belak wants a culprit for the flood before the king asks.
The widows of thirty diggers demand blood-silver of sixty sables each.
Jaroslav's tavern talk reaches the Keeper's informers.

FX25-110.name: House Bystrin
FX25-110.title: Knight of the Ostec March
FX25-110.arms: a silver chevron on green, between three black reeds

military.office: Banner-knights of the Ostec Lances at the Ostmir Gate
military.unit: a banner of the Ostec Lances, 25 lances at the Ostmir Gate
military.ties: Bystrin knights have held a banner at the Ostmir Gate since the Korens took the lordless farms beyond it, and their sons learn to charge across marsh before they learn their letters.

FX25-110.power: A knight's manor on the lordless farms south of Yarec and a banner of the Ostec Lances.
FX25-110.history: When the Tessarian governors fled the Free Marches in 1045 and 1047, Ostoja Bystrin rode out of the Ostmir Gate for House Koren and took the lordless farms beyond it, and the Korens knighted him for it. His line has served in the Ostec Lances since and hoped for more. Sir Kresimir Bystrin waited twenty years for the captaincy of the Bear Guard, and Zoran Koren gave it to Varin Strak. In 1103 his daughter married a half-orc axeman of Greytusk's company at Coreria, and the Korens, who will grant no march land to half-orcs, have not been told about the grandson.
FX25-110.reputation: Hard-riding marcher knights, ambitious and a little bitter.

members.role: Head of the house; Knight of the Ostec March
members.note: He waited twenty years for the Bear Guard, and Zoran Koren gave it to a Strak.

members.role: His wife; mistress of the horse lines
members.note: She runs the manor and the horse lines and quietly sends silver south to her daughter.

members.role: Heir; knight at the Ostmir Gate
members.note: He serves at the Ostmir Gate and watches Dana Veskov's lances watching him back.

members.role: Daughter; married in the Neck
members.note: She married a half-orc sergeant of Greytusk's company at Coreria in 1103 and has borne him a son.

famousDead: Took the lordless farms south of the Ostmir Gate for House Koren in 1047.
FX25-110.secret: Branka Bystrin's husband is a half-orc of Greytusk's company, and the Korens do not know the Bystrins have a half-orc grandson who stands to inherit.
hooks: Branka comes home from the Neck with her husband and son.
Kresimir is promised the Bear Guard if Varin Strak falls.
Bystrin and Veskov lances meet on the Ostmir road.

FX25-111.name: House Zhelnik
FX25-111.title: Castellan of Kamogda Kremlin
FX25-111.arms: a grey kremlin gate on red

military.office: Hereditary castellans of Kamogda Kremlin and the Tolek river forts
military.unit: the Tolek Vale river forts, 2,400 crossbows and spears facing Drevna
military.ties: Since the Lakeland War the Zhelniks have held the river forts against Drevna, and the Lord Marshal's border orders always go first to the castellan of Kamogda.

FX25-111.power: Kamogda Kremlin and the chain of river forts on the Tolek, and the right to search every barge that comes down from the Lakeland.
FX25-111.history: Ctibor Zhelnik was a crossbow sergeant who lived through the winter siege of Brodava in 1035 and 1036 and walked home across the ice when it failed. After the Peace of Polov, the regent Anka Tolmir built Kamogda Kremlin to watch the new border and gave it to him in 1038. The Zhelniks have kept it since, with the river forts of the Tolek Vale, and search every barge from the Lakeland to the plank. When Drevna raised the silk toll at Lubany in 1100 and King Stanislav threatened to close the Tolek, it was a Zhelnik who would have closed it. Twice since then the castellan has sent men across the frozen border at night to break Drevnan fish-weirs, which the Peace of Polov forbids.
FX25-111.reputation: Grim, thorough border-keepers whom every bargeman on the Tolek curses.

members.role: Head of the house; Castellan of Kamogda Kremlin
members.note: His grandfather froze half to death at Brodava, and he has never let a Drevnan barge pass his forts unsearched.

members.role: Heir; captain of the lower forts
members.note: She has twice chased the Korov river pirate to the border and twice been ordered not to cross.

members.role: Son; crossbow captain
members.note: He led the second weir raid across the ice himself and wants to burn the pirate's boats next.

members.role: Ctibor's wife; born a Krovan
members.note: She writes to her brother at Velany about every silk barge, and he passes it to the Purse Bench.

famousDead: Survived the winter siege of Brodava and became the first castellan of Kamogda in 1038.
FX25-111.secret: The castellan has sent men across the frozen border twice to break Drevnan weirs, against the Peace of Polov, and Drevna's listeners already know it.
hooks: The king orders the Tolek closed to Drevnan barges.
Zbynek crosses the border a third time and does not come back.
Drevnan envoys demand that the weir raiders be handed over.

FX25-112.name: the Hornaks of Lubyn
FX25-112.title: Keeper of Lubyn Kremlin and its Beacon
FX25-112.arms: a gold beacon flame on dark slate blue

military.office: Keepers of Lubyn Kremlin and its beacon
military.unit: the Lubyn garrison, 120 crossbows and the beacon crew
military.ties: Lubyn's beacon carries the channel watch's fires over the East Rift Heights to the Bear Keep in under an hour, and a Hornak has lit it in every alarm since 1008.

FX25-112.power: A small stone kremlin high on the East Rift Heights, its beacon, and the hamlet of a thousand souls that feeds it.
FX25-112.history: In the War of the Channel King Bogdan built Lubyn Kremlin on a bare shoulder of the East Rift Heights, to pass the toll forts' warning fires over the mountains to Velgrad. Sergeant Hostivit Hornak lit its first fire when the Greyhaven galleys came for Sevina in 1009, and he was knighted for it. The Hornaks have kept the beacon since, the loneliest post in the kingdom. From Lubyn they watched the black column of 1071 rise off the far shore and smelled the smoke on the wind, and they laughed at Greyhaven's dragon with the rest of Velgrad. In December 1104 the castellan received a sealed order from the Channel-Master: on any night in July, whatever burns on the channel, the beacon is not to be lit.
FX25-112.reputation: Lonely, weathered, dependable mountain folk; the kingdom forgets them until it needs a fire.

members.role: Head of the house; Keeper of Lubyn Kremlin
members.note: He has a sealed order to light no fire on any July night, whatever burns, and he does not like it.

members.role: Heir; captain of the beacon crew
members.note: She watched the black column of 1071 from the beacon at nine, and she knows it was smoke, because she smelled it.

members.role: Son
members.note: He keeps the beacon pyre dry through the winter and talks to the ravens more than to people.

members.role: Grandmother
members.note: She refuses to move down to the valley and says she will die at the beacon as her husband did.

famousDead: Lit Lubyn's first warning fire in 1009 and was knighted for it.
FX25-112.secret: The Hornaks hold a sealed order from the Channel-Master to light no beacon on any July night, which means someone already knows what will burn.
hooks: A fire on the channel in July, and an order not to light.
Goranka rides down to Velgrad to ask who signed the order.
A stranger climbs to Lubyn asking about the smoke of 1071.

FX25-113.name: the Kosars of Bear Hill
FX25-113.sur: son or daughter of the father; called Kosar by byname
FX25-113.title: Sergeant of the Bear Guard
FX25-113.arms: a sign: a black great-axe on red, painted over their cookshop door

military.office: Hereditary sergeants of the Bear Guard
military.unit: the Bear Guard, 600 great-axemen of the Bear Keep
military.ties: Since Radoslav founded the Bear Guard from the tallest men of the realm in 962 there has always been a Kosar sergeant in it, and Kosar boys are measured at Midwinter like princes.

FX25-113.power: Sergeants' places in the Bear Guard, a cookshop on Bear Hill where the guard eat, and the trust of the Master of the Hall of the Bear.
FX25-113.history: The first Kosar was a peasant giant who mowed hay with a scythe no other man could swing, and Radoslav the Bear took him into the first Bear Guard in 962. His sons and grandsons grew nearly as tall, and Bear Hill says, quietly, that a Sevrin prince once visited the Kosar hayfields. Every generation since has given the Guard a sergeant and learned the great-axe in the Hall of the Bear. The present sergeant spars with the king when Ruslan Hardhand is not looking. His son, on night watch in the Bear Keep in December 1104, saw Prince Radoslav's nurse at the notched doorpost with a knife.
FX25-113.reputation: Huge, gentle, loyal men and big-armed women who feed the whole Guard.

members.role: Head of the family; Sergeant of the Bear Guard
members.note: A head over other men, he is the tallest man in the Guard after the king, and the king spars with him when Ruslan Hardhand is not looking.

members.role: His wife; keeps the cookshop on Bear Hill
members.note: The Guard eat at her tables, and she hears everything they say about the king's eyes.

members.role: Son; guardsman of the Bear Guard
members.note: He saw the prince's nurse at the doorpost with a knife one night in December and does not know whom to tell.

members.role: Youngest son
members.note: At ten he is already as tall as a grown man, and the Lower Town bets on how tall he will grow.

famousDead: Peasant giant who stood in Radoslav's first Bear Guard in 962.
FX25-113.secret: Branko saw the prince's nurse cut a false notch on the Midwinter doorpost, and his father has told him to forget it for the family's sake.
hooks: Branko tries to sell what he saw and picks the wrong buyer.
The king's eyes fail him in a bout with Vukasin.
Varin Strak asks the Kosars to report on Ruslan Hardhand.

FX25-114.name: House Strelnik
FX25-114.title: Master of the Crown Bolt-Yard
FX25-114.arms: a black crossbow on wine red, three gold bolts beneath

military.office: Hereditary captains of the crown crossbow companies
military.unit: the crown crossbow companies, 3,000 men at Velgrad, Mirovo, Sevany and Koritsa
military.ties: Every crown crossbowman learns the Strelnik loading drill, and the Strelnik bolt-yard at Mirgrad fills the arsenal's chests.

FX25-114.power: The crown bolt-yard at Mirgrad, captaincies in the crown crossbow companies, and a crossbow workshop that sold weapons to both sides of more than one war.
FX25-114.history: Zbynek Strelnik was taken prisoner at Brodava in 1036, where the Drevnan women shot crossbows from the walls, and he learned the crossbow in a Drevnan camp before the Peace of Polov sent him home. The regent Anka Tolmir made him master of a new crown bolt-yard in 1036, and his family has led the crown crossbow companies since. In the Tusk War Velgrad stayed out and sold crossbows to Drevna at a good price, and most of them were Strelnik crossbows. Since the silk toll quarrel of 1100 the king has forbidden that trade. The bolt-yard still sells to Drevnan buyers through a middleman at Koritsa.
FX25-114.reputation: Exact, prosperous soldier-craftsmen, rather too fond of a good price.

members.role: Head of the house; Master of the Crown Bolt-Yard
members.note: He never asks the Koritsa middleman where the bolts go, and he always counts the silver twice.

members.role: Heir; captain of the Mirovo crossbow company
members.note: She has found Strelnik marks on bolts taken from Drevnan river pirates and wants to know how they got there.

members.role: Son; captain of the Sevany crossbow company
members.note: He has been told to pick his steadiest men for 'a July night's work' and has picked them.

members.role: Grandmother; daughter of the founder
members.note: She still files bolt-heads and says nobody else in the yard gets the weight right.

famousDead: Learned the crossbow as a prisoner in Drevna and founded the crown bolt-yard in 1036.
FX25-114.secret: The Strelnik bolt-yard still sells crossbows and bolts to Drevnan buyers through a Koritsa middleman, against the king's ban of 1100.
hooks: Rada traces the pirate's bolts back to her own yard.
Nenad's July crossbowmen are ordered aboard the tow galleys.
The Keeper of the Seal's couriers stop the Koritsa middleman's cart.

FX25-115.name: the Sevinets
FX25-115.sur: son or daughter of the father; called Sevinets after their burned town
FX25-115.title: Sergeant of the Sevany Hooks
FX25-115.arms: a sign: a black grapnel-anchor on dark red, tattooed on the forearm

military.office: Sergeants of the Sevany Hooks
military.unit: the Sevany Hooks, 1,600 marines, with the 800 half-orc galley axemen
military.ties: Since the Hooks were raised in 1010 a Sevinets has thrown the first grapnel in every boarding drill, and the family's half-orc kin stand with the galley axemen.

FX25-115.power: Sergeants' places in the Sevany Hooks, a row of fishers' houses rebuilt on the Sevina shore, and the ear of the Channel-Master.
FX25-115.history: The Sevinets were fishers of Sevina whose boats burned with the rest in 1009. When the Channel-Master raised the Sevany Hooks in 1010, the men of the family took the marines' pay rather than build new boats, and they have thrown grapnels for the squadron ever since. In the 1040s a Sevinets married the daughter of a half-orc galley axeman, and some of the family carry small tusks and stand with the half-orc axemen of Sevany. Their sergeant knows the July plan, because the Channel-Master needed men who hate Greyhaven to crew the fire rafts. His youngest son has been put on a raft crew and does not want to burn.
FX25-115.reputation: Hard, scarred, revenge-hungry marines; the Hooks' backbone.

members.role: Head of the family; Sergeant of the Sevany Hooks
members.note: He has asked to steer the first fire raft himself on the July dusk.

members.role: His wife; bonesetter of the Hooks
members.note: She binds burns for the Hooks and knows exactly what burning pitch does to skin.

members.role: Daughter; marine of the Hooks
members.note: She has her grandmother's tusks and the best grapnel arm in the Hooks.

members.role: Youngest son; rower on a raft crew
members.note: He has told a girl in Droin that he will be on a fire raft in July, and that he is afraid.

famousDead: Fisher of Sevina who lost his boat in 1009 and joined the first Hooks.
FX25-115.secret: Vratko knows the July plan and has sworn his crew to it, and his son Dusan has already told an outsider.
hooks: Dusan's girl in Droin repeats what he told her.
Vratko is offered the first raft if he will name the men who doubt.
Milica must choose between her father's revenge and her brother's life.

FX25-116.name: House Radkov
FX25-116.title: Bearer of the Lamp Banner
FX25-116.arms: a red cross of four lamp-flames on white

military.office: Hereditary Bearers of the Lamp Banner before the king
military.unit: the banner guard of the royal host, 60 Bench knights
military.ties: In every royal host since Lake Ostec the red Lamp Banner has gone before the king in a Radkov's hands, and the army turns where it turns.

FX25-116.power: A knight's manor in Velany, a crown stipend, and the honor of carrying the realm's holiest banner.
FX25-116.history: At Lake Ostec in September 957 the bearer of the red Lamp Banner fell in the marsh, and a young knight named Radko caught the banner before it touched the water. Radoslav the Bear gave him a manor in Velany and his family the duty of carrying it before the king forever. Sir Velislav Radkov carried it at Kraina in 1034 and on the ice before Brodava through the winter of 1035. When the siege broke, the banner the Radkovs brought home had been sewn in a Velgrad workshop in a single night; the true one went through the ice with Sir Velislav's horse, and the family has kept that to itself for seventy years.
FX25-116.reputation: Devout, ceremonious knights whom the Patriarch blesses by name every Dawn Feast.

members.role: Head of the house; Bearer of the Lamp Banner
members.note: He carries the banner at every crowning and procession and kisses its hem each morning, knowing what it is.

members.role: His wife
members.note: She embroiders a new fringe for the banner every Dawn Feast and does not know it is a copy.

members.role: Heir; banner guard
members.note: He wants the banner carried to the Neck to bless Andros's spring march.

members.role: Daughter
members.note: She found her great-grandfather's confession about the ice in the chapel loft last summer.

famousDead: Caught the Lamp Banner when its bearer fell at Lake Ostec in 957.
Carried the banner at Kraina and on the Brodava ice, and lost it there.
FX25-116.secret: The true Lamp Banner went through the Brodava ice in 1036; the Radkovs carry a copy, and the Drevnans say the original hangs in an island monastery.
hooks: A Drevnan monk offers to sell the true banner back.
Danica shows the confession to her brother.
The king asks for the banner to be carried south to Andros.

FX25-117.name: the Lampadins
FX25-117.title: Keeper of the Cathedral Lamp
FX25-117.arms: a gold sun shaped as a lamp-flame, on white
FX25-117.power: The keeping of the great lamp of the Dawn Cathedral, a second key to the cathedral library, and three generations of married priests on Lamp Street.
FX25-117.history: Father Svetoslav Lampadin lit the great lamp of the Dawn Cathedral at its consecration on Dawn Feast 772, and his descendants have lit it before every dawn crowning since. The Dawn Church lets its priests marry, and the office has passed from father to son for 333 years along with a second key to the library's locked press. The Lampadins lead the Lamp Party's prayers and stand beside Patriarch Kirill. In December 1104 Brother Teodor Lampadin, the cathedral librarian, was found frozen in the snow below Bear Hill with the key to the locked press in his fist. His brother, the present keeper, had read the first of the eleven letters in that press the week before.
FX25-117.reputation: Gentle, learned, devout keepers of the lamp; the cathedral's oldest family.

members.role: Head of the family; Keeper of the Cathedral Lamp
members.note: He lit the lamp for Stanislav's crowning and has prayed every night since for the king's eyes.

members.role: Heir; priest and keeper of the second library key
members.note: He has read the first of Bogumil's eleven letters, and his brother died the night he took the key to read the rest.

members.role: Predrag's wife; leader of the cathedral choir
members.note: She leads the women's voices at the Dawn Liturgy and has noticed which bishops stopped singing after Teodor died.

members.role: Daughter; icon-copyist
members.note: She copies icons on Lamp Street and has seen her father weep over a letter he would not let her read.

famousDead: Lit the great lamp at the cathedral's consecration in 772.
Cathedral librarian; found frozen in the snow in December 1104 with the key to the locked press in his fist.
FX25-117.secret: Father Predrag has read the first of the eleven Bogumil letters, and he believes his brother Teodor was left to freeze for trying to read the rest.
hooks: Someone wants the second library key and will pay for it.
Predrag asks a stranger to read a letter he dare not finish.
Patriarch Kirill asks the family to name who had the key last.

FX25-118.name: the Shelkov silk house
FX25-118.title: Master of the Shelkov Silk House
FX25-118.arms: a purple silk rose on pale lilac
FX25-118.power: Warehouses at Vyova and a factor at Lubany, credit with the channel buyers, and a quiet supply of silk that never paid the Lubany tenth.
FX25-118.history: When the Treaty of Thardush opened the Silk Road through the Lakeland in 1066, Sobeslav Shelkov's father began buying silk at Lubany and re-selling it on the channel at Vyova, and by 1080 the house was the largest silk re-seller in Velgrad. Drevna's silk toll rises of 1100 and 1103 cut its profits by a third. Since then the Shelkovs have bought part of their silk from Drevnan lake smugglers who run it past the Lubany staple over the frozen Western Lakes. Borek Marten of the Fur Staple wants silk under the Staple too, and the Shelkovs mean to stop him.
FX25-118.reputation: Clever, well-dressed merchants with friends on both sides of every border.

members.role: Head of the house
members.note: He wears Lakeland silk in a land of furs and says it is the best advertisement there is.

members.role: Heir; mistress of the Vyova warehouses
members.note: She is fighting Borek Marten's plan to bring silk under the Fur Staple, and she is winning.

members.role: Son; factor at Lubany
members.note: He lives at Lubany under House Lubec's nose and buys the smuggled silk on the ice at night.

members.role: Sobeslav's wife
members.note: She keeps the true books in her own hand and burns the old ones every Dawn Feast.

FX25-118.secret: The Shelkovs buy silk smuggled past the Lubany staple by Drevnan lake smugglers, and their factor Mladen meets the smugglers on the ice himself.
hooks: House Lubec's men catch Mladen on the ice.
Borek Marten offers to forget the smuggling if the Shelkovs back his silk staple.
A bale of smuggled silk is found with a Drevnan crown seal still on it.

FX25-119.name: the Nakovals of Smiths' End
FX25-119.title: Elder of the Smiths of Smiths' End
FX25-119.arms: a black anvil on burnt orange
FX25-119.power: The eldership of the smiths of Smiths' End by the east gate, the Bear Guard's axe contract, and the dies for the Fur Staple's grading seals.
FX25-119.history: The Nakovals have worked Redcrown iron at Smiths' End by the east gate since 905. Since 962 they have forged the great-axes of the Bear Guard, and since Lubomir's day they have cut the iron dies with which the Fur Staple brands every graded pelt. Their elder is the voice of the smiths in Velgrad, and he does not trust the few dwarf smiths who work there. His daughter works for one of them anyway. His son has made spare grading dies for the Marten Boys, the Lower Town gang that steals graded pelts from the Staple yard.
FX25-119.reputation: Proud, hot-tempered smiths who make the best axes in the east.

members.role: Head of the family; Elder of the Smiths
members.note: He forged the king's own great-axe in 1090 and says no dwarf could have balanced it better.

members.role: His wife
members.note: She runs the forge accounts and knows the axe contract is worth more than the rest of the trade together.

members.role: Daughter; journeywoman to a dwarf smith
members.note: She works for a dwarf smith of Smiths' End, and the guild calls it treason to the craft.

members.role: Son and heir
members.note: He cut two spare Staple grading dies for Ivo Shortcoat's Marten Boys and was paid in sables.

famousDead: Opened the first Nakoval forge at Smiths' End in 905.
FX25-119.secret: Borivoj Nakoval cut spare Fur Staple grading dies for the Marten Boys, so the gang's stolen pelts pass as graded.
hooks: The Fur Staple finds two pelts with perfect brands that were never graded.
Jarka's dwarf master offers to teach her a secret of the forge, for a price.
The king's great-axe cracks in practice and the Nakovals are summoned.

FX25-120.name: the Burevoy captains
FX25-120.title: Captain of the galley Storm-Bear
FX25-120.arms: a black galley on red, under a white storm-cloud
FX25-120.power: Captaincies in the channel squadron, a house and boat-sheds at Droin, and pilots who know every creek of the east shore.
FX25-120.history: Captain Hostimil Burevoy held the Velgradan line in the tide race off Beaconstone in July 1008 beside Kazimir Volan, and his family has captained galleys of the channel squadron ever since. They are the squadron's best seamen and its proudest, and they despise toll clerks and the men who fight with fire. Captain Rostislav Burevoy has told Radek Volan to his face that fire rafts are a coward's war. His son has been given the tow galley that will lead the rafts out, and his daughter knows the tides of the creek below Mount Dobava better than any pilot in the squadron.
FX25-120.reputation: Honorable, salt-hard galley captains; the squadron's pride.

members.role: Head of the family; Captain of the Storm-Bear
members.note: He thinks fire rafts are a coward's war and has said so to the Channel-Master's face.

members.role: His wife
members.note: She keeps the family's boat-sheds and has asked her husband to retire before July.

members.role: Heir; captain of a tow galley
members.note: He has been given the tow galley that will lead the rafts out, and he wants the glory his father refuses.

members.role: Daughter; pilot
members.note: She knows the tides of the creek below Mount Dobava better than anyone in the squadron and has been told to guide the rafts out.

famousDead: Held the Velgradan line in the tide race off Beaconstone beside Kazimir Volan in 1008.
FX25-120.secret: Captain Rostislav has written a letter to the Patriarch calling the fire rafts a sin, and has not yet decided whether to send it.
hooks: Father and son quarrel on the quay before the squadron sails.
Dubravka is asked by a stranger which tide the rafts will use.
The Patriarch receives a sealed letter from Droin.

FX25-121.name: the Sobolin trappers
FX25-121.sur: son or daughter of the father; the Sobolins by byname
FX25-121.title: Elder of the Sobolin Trap Lines
FX25-121.arms: a sign: a brown stag's head burned into their sled boards
FX25-121.power: Two hundred trap lines in the North Woods, sled teams, and knowledge of the forest that no lord owns.
FX25-121.history: The Sobolins have trapped sable and marten in the North Woods since King Lubomir chartered the Fur Staple in 870 and pelts became coin. The Black Cough of 917 emptied their villages along the Fur Road, and the survivors went deeper into the forest. A Sobolin trapper's son and a Solgrad trapper's son once shared a winter camp; the Solgrad boy became Borek Marten, and the Sobolins now owe his house more than they catch in three winters. Their elder remembers where the Marten fortune began. His grandson has started selling pelts to the Lisovik knights' daughter, who sells them past the Staple.
FX25-121.reputation: Silent forest folk who know the North Woods better than the ski-runners.

members.role: Head of the clan; Elder of the trap lines
members.note: He trapped beside Borek Marten's father and knows where the first Marten bale really came from.

members.role: Heir; runs the sled teams
members.note: She drives the clan's furs to Dobina every winter and pays Marten's men with her jaw set.

members.role: Grandson
members.note: He sells the clan's best sables to Olesya Lisovik behind his grandfather's back.

members.role: Great-granddaughter
members.note: At seven she can set a sable snare in the dark.

famousDead: First of the clan to sell pelts to the Fur Staple in 870.
FX25-121.secret: Old Mojmir knows that the Marten fortune began with a bale of sables stolen from the Tolmir clerks' sledge in 1061.
hooks: Mojmir is asked what he knows about Borek Marten's first bale.
Premysl is caught with Staple-free pelts at Droin.
A ski-runner patrol finds a stranger's camp on the Sobolin lines.

FX25-122.name: the Lekarins
FX25-122.title: Physician of the Bear Keep
FX25-122.arms: a green serpent around a staff, on white
FX25-122.power: The office of Physician of the Bear Keep, the Sevrin height rolls kept since 981, and the secrets of every royal body.
FX25-122.history: Master Lekar sat with Radoslav the Bear when his swollen heart stopped in 981, and he began the rolls in which the family has measured every Sevrin since. The Lekarins have been physicians of the Bear Keep for 124 years. They watched Miroslav's heart fail at 47, and they keep the doorpost notches in a book as well as in wood. The old physician has read the rolls against King Stanislav's headaches and told him, alone, how long he may have. His younger son sells a weekly word on the king's health to Zoran Koren.
FX25-122.reputation: Learned, discreet physicians; nobody in Velgrad knows more about the king.

members.role: Head of the family; Physician of the Bear Keep
members.note: He has told the king, alone, that by the rolls he has perhaps five years.

members.role: His wife; midwife to the queen
members.note: She delivered Prince Radoslav and the child who died in 1102.

members.role: Heir; physician
members.note: She measures the young prince every month and has noticed that the doorpost and her book do not agree.

members.role: Younger son; apothecary
members.note: Zoran Koren pays him for a weekly word on the king's health, the same news Varin Strak sends.

famousDead: Sat with Radoslav the Bear when his heart failed in 981 and began the Sevrin height rolls.
FX25-122.secret: The Lekarin rolls show that no Sevrin a head and more over other men has lived past 48, and Mirna's measurements show the prince's doorpost notch is false.
hooks: Mirna must decide whom to tell about the false notch.
Jaromir's weekly report to Koren is intercepted.
The king goes blind at table and the physician is sent for.

FX25-123.name: the Mglins of the Vyova fog
FX25-123.sur: son or daughter of the father; called Mglin, 'of the fog'
FX25-123.title: Old Man of the Fog-Boats
FX25-123.arms: a sign: a knot of black rope, tied in the bow of every boat
FX25-123.power: Twelve fast fog-boats, hidden landings on both shores of the channel, and forty men who can row without a sound.
FX25-123.history: The Mglins began running cargoes past the toll forts the year the forts were built, in 1010, and they have done it ever since in the channel fogs, which are thick nine days in ten in autumn. They carry furs and silk west to Greyhaven buyers, wine and cloth east, and sometimes men: debtors escaping the rowing benches and spies who cannot take the ferry. The Ledovans hang one or two Mglins most years. Since 1096 they have carried a sealed packet across the channel every new moon for a rope merchant in Sevany, and they have never opened it.
FX25-123.reputation: Ghosts of the channel fog; feared by toll clerks and loved by the poor of Vyova.

members.role: Head of the clan; Old Man of the Fog-Boats
members.note: He has rowed the channel blind more than a thousand times and can tell the shore by the smell.

members.role: Heir; master of the fast boats
members.note: She rowed a debtor's whole family across in December under the noses of the Grey Pike.

members.role: Son
members.note: He wants to open the rope merchant's packet and sell it to the Keeper of the Seal.

members.role: Granddaughter
members.note: She sells fish on the Vyova quay and counts the toll galleys' oars for her grandfather.

famousDead: Ran the first cargo past the new Sevany toll fort in 1010 and was never caught.
FX25-123.secret: The packet the Mglins carry every new moon is the Greyhaven Admiral's spy's report from Sevany, and they do not know who reads it.
hooks: Spytihnev opens the packet.
A debtor's daughter pays the Mglins to take her to a raft crew.
The Grey Pike catches a fog-boat with a Greyhaven pilot aboard.

FX25-124.name: the Konev studs
FX25-124.title: Master of the Konev Studs
FX25-124.arms: a white destrier rearing on brown
FX25-124.power: The studs of Velin, where half the destriers of the Ostec Lances are bred, and a long list of lords who owe for horses.
FX25-124.history: When the Korens raised the Ostec Lances after 958 they needed big horses, and the Konevs, horse-copers of Velin, began breeding destriers from Tessarian stallions and upland mares. They supply half the 2,400 destriers of the Lances in 1105, and House Koren pays for them late or not at all. Since 1100 the Konevs have sold remounts in the Neck as well, through an Ostran dealer who asks no questions. Three hundred of those horses are now carrying Queen Livia's riders against Velgrad's own volunteers.
FX25-124.reputation: Hard-headed horse-breeders who love their horses more than their lords.

members.role: Head of the family; Master of the Studs
members.note: He keeps a list of every unpaid Koren horse, and the list is longer than the Koren stable.

members.role: Heir
members.note: She can tell a horse's temper from its eyes and refuses to sell to men who beat them.

members.role: Son; dealer in the Neck
members.note: He delivers the remounts to the Ostran dealer at Calossa and has seen whose riders take them.

members.role: Grandmother
members.note: She bred the stallion that carried Zoran Koren to the Neck in 1075 and says he still owes her for it.

famousDead: Bred the first destriers for the Ostec Lances.
FX25-124.secret: The Konevs have sold 300 remounts through an Ostran dealer to Queen Livia's buyers, so Velgradan horses now carry both sides of the war in the Neck.
hooks: A Vranek knight in the Neck recognizes a Konev brand on an enemy horse.
House Koren finally pays, and asks for a favor with the silver.
Bratomil wants out before he is caught at Calossa.

FX26-201.name: House Jezeran
FX26-201.title: Lake Lord of Radov
FX26-201.arms: a silver water lily on deep blue, under a gold crown

military.office: Lake lord of Radov and colonel of its regiment
military.unit: the Radov regiment, 1,500 hearth-roll crossbows and 80 lake-lord knights
military.ties: The Radov regiment has marched in every royal host since 802, and its crossbows held the burning line behind Kraina in 1034 while the queen pulled back.

FX26-201.power: The city of Radov and its lakes, fish-weirs and forests, and one of the oldest voices on the Lake Council.
FX26-201.history: The Jezerans were lake lords of Radov when the lords of the Lakeland still met each New Year's Day at Drevna only to reckon their debts. In May 802 Lord Vojslav Jezeran seconded the crowning of Dragomir Dravic, and the house has sat beside the throne on the Lake Council ever since. In 1034 the Jezerans burned their own granaries in front of King Miroslav's army on the queen's order, and in 1038 they lost half their bound tenants when Ludmila freed the levies, which they grumbled about for a generation. In 1105 the Lake Council must decide on the withheld rye and on Pavel Brodar's demand to set the heir aside, and the Jezeran vote may decide both. Lord Dobromil has promised it to both sides.
FX26-201.reputation: Old, rich, careful lake lords who never vote until they know who will win.

members.role: Head of the house; Lake Lord of Radov
members.note: Both the Prince-Consort and the Queen's Ear have visited him since Midwinter, and he has promised his vote to each of them.

members.role: His wife
members.note: She confesses to an island monk every week and tells him more about the council than about her sins.

members.role: Heir; colonel of the Radov crossbows
members.note: She trained beside Mara Zorac at the Zorin Crossbow Yard and says the rye roads are as safe as a church.

members.role: Younger son
members.note: He owes 900 suns to the Brodar sled house and would sell his father's vote to clear it.

famousDead: Seconded Dragomir Dravic's crowning at the Lake Council of May 802.
FX26-201.secret: Lord Dobromil has promised his Lake Council vote to both Pavel Brodar and Nadia Lark, and his son's debts to the Brodar sled house may decide which promise he keeps.
hooks: The Lake Council votes, and Lord Dobromil must finally choose.
Lada tells the council the rye roads are safe, against her father's wish.
The Brodar sled house calls in Stepan's debt the night before the vote.

FX26-202.name: House Pchelin
FX26-202.title: Lord of Darsky; Keeper of the Royal Hives
FX26-202.arms: a gold and black honeycomb chequy
FX26-202.power: The market town of Darsky, the royal honey and wax estates around it, and the wax in which half the kingdom's fines are paid.
FX26-202.history: The Pchelins were free beekeepers of the Crown Lakes who carried wax to the walls of Brodava in 1035 to seal the arrow wounds of the defenders, and in 1038 Queen Ludmila made Bogdana Pchelin baroness of Darsky and keeper of the royal hives. Under Ludmila's Code fines may be paid in bears, furs or wax, and much of that wax comes from Pchelin hives. The house is rich, sweet-spoken and sharp. Its free neighbors include the Birchwoods, whose daughter Alena married Prince Yaromir at dawn on Harvest Home 1104. A Pchelin hive-warden watched the wedding from the reeds.
FX26-202.reputation: Rich, honeyed and quick to sting; the queen's beekeepers.

members.role: Head of the house; Baroness of Darsky
members.note: She knows about the prince's dawn wedding and is weighing whether the secret is worth more to the queen or to the Prince-Consort.

members.role: Heir
members.note: He courted Alena Birchwood himself for two summers and has not forgiven the prince.

members.role: Daughter; mistress of the wax sheds
members.note: She is Alena's friend and was the second witness at the wedding, which her mother does not know.

members.role: Bozena's uncle; old hive-warden
members.note: He talks to the bees each morning and swears they told him the prince would marry beneath him.

famousDead: Carried wax to the walls of Brodava in 1035 and was made baroness of Darsky in 1038.
FX26-202.secret: A Pchelin daughter was a witness at Prince Yaromir's secret wedding, and her mother, who knows of the wedding but not of her daughter's part, means to sell the secret.
hooks: Alena Birchwood's hives burn, and the Pchelins are blamed.
Bozena sends a jar of honey and a letter to the Listening Tower.
Velislav challenges a man who mocks the beekeeper's daughter.

FX26-203.name: House Krainov
FX26-203.title: Lord of Kraina; Warden of the Western Border
FX26-203.arms: a red flame over a black granary, on gold

military.office: Wardens of the Kraina border
military.unit: the Kraina garrison, 1,800 crossbows and spears facing Velgrad
military.ties: The Krainovs hold the western border where Velgrad came in 1034, and their crossbows stand first in the line whenever the Lord Marshal fears the west.

FX26-203.power: The border city of Kraina, its garrison, and the memory of the battle that Velgrad won and lost.
FX26-203.history: Mstislav Krainov was the queen's steward at Kraina in June 1034 when King Miroslav beat her army there. On Ludmila's order he burned every granary and hay barn between Kraina and the lakes ahead of the Velgradan army, including his own, and that hunger began the ruin of Miroslav's war. In 1038 the queen made his son baron of Kraina and warden of the western border. The Krainovs have watched Velgrad across the Western Lakes ever since. Since 1102 Velgradan raiders from Kamogda have crossed the ice twice to break Krainov fish-weirs, and the young lord wants to answer in kind.
FX26-203.reputation: Fierce, poor, unforgiving border lords; the first to fight and the last to forget.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of Kraina
members.note: He keeps a charred beam from his grandfather's granary over the hall door.

members.role: Heir; captain of the lake posts
members.note: She has the names of the Velgradan weir raiders, from a Kamogda soldier who drinks across the ice.

members.role: Son
members.note: He wants to cross the ice to Kamogda with fifty crossbows and burn a Velgradan granary for every broken weir.

members.role: Mstislav's wife
members.note: She buries the border's dead and keeps a list of every one since 1080.

famousDead: Burned the granaries ahead of Miroslav's army in 1034.
FX26-203.secret: Nevena Krainov pays a Kamogda soldier for news across the ice, and he has told her that the Velgradan castellan acted without the king's leave.
hooks: Rostislav crosses the ice for revenge.
The Velgradan raiders come a third time, and Nevena is waiting.
The queen's envoys want the Krainovs quiet while the Greyhaven match is made.

FX26-204.name: House Jazovic
FX26-204.title: Knight of the Polgrad Weirs
FX26-204.arms: five black weir-stakes on sea green

military.office: Captains of the Polgrad river garrison
military.unit: the weir posts of the Middle Dromir, 300 men of the river garrisons
military.ties: Jazovic knights command the posts that watch the Dromir below Polgrad, and every barge that passes them is counted for the silk staple.

FX26-204.power: Three fish-weirs on the middle Dromir, the toll on barges that pass them, and a knight's manor outside Polgrad.
FX26-204.history: When Queen Ludmila gave House Lubec the silk staple in 1012, the Lubecs needed men to watch the Dromir below Lubany, and they knighted their weir-keeper Bratko Jazovic. The Jazovics have kept the weirs and counted the barges since. In 1065 two thousand Tusk riders burned Polgrad's granaries and suburbs, and the Jazovic manor with them. Since 1100, when Velgrad threatened to close the Tolek, the Rivermen's Guild has paid a river pirate to rob Velgradan fur barges on the Dromir. The pirate's boats hide behind a Jazovic weir.
FX26-204.reputation: Plain river knights who know every eddy of the Dromir and every bargeman's debts.

members.role: Head of the house; Knight of the Polgrad Weirs
members.note: He takes a tenth of the pirate's take for the hiding place and calls it weir rent.

members.role: Heir
members.note: She caught the pirate's men unloading behind the south weir and was told by her father to forget it.

members.role: Son
members.note: He rows with the pirate's crew for the thrill and has robbed two Velgradan barges himself.

members.role: Grandmother
members.note: She ran from the burning manor in 1065 with a baby under each arm and never lets anyone forget it.

famousDead: First weir-keeper knighted by House Lubec in 1012.
FX26-204.secret: The river pirate who robs Velgradan fur barges hides his boats behind a Jazovic weir, and the Jazovics take a tenth of the plunder.
hooks: Gregor Stillwater's men come looking for the pirate.
A robbed Velgradan bargeman recognizes Danilo.
Iskra must choose between her father and the queen's peace.

FX26-205.name: House Borovik
FX26-205.title: Lord of Belek
FX26-205.arms: a dark green pine tree on white, over black water

military.office: Captains of the Brodar sled trains
military.unit: the Belek sled train, 200 sleds and 400 drivers for the Sled Riders
military.ties: Borovik sleds and drivers carry the Sled Riders' food and bolts over the frozen lakes, and the family drove beside Vasil Brodar on the first night run of 1035.

FX26-205.power: The town of Belek, its pine forests, tar pits and potash ovens, and two hundred sleds.
FX26-205.history: Ratibor Borovik drove one of the 600 sleds that crossed the frozen lake to Brodava with food on the first night of the siege in 1035, beside Vasil Brodar. When the Brodars became lords, they made the Boroviks barons of Belek under them in 1040, and the two houses have been bound together since. The Boroviks burn tar and potash and build sleds for the winter roads. Lord Ratibor's grandson leads the Prince's Party's votes in the Lake Council for Pavel Brodar. The Harvest Home drum that felled the heir was bought in Belek.
FX26-205.reputation: Sturdy, loyal Brodar men, rough and ready, with tar under their nails.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of Belek
members.note: He leads the Prince's Party votes and believes, honestly, that a woman who faints at drums cannot hold the steppe.

members.role: Heir; master of the sled train
members.note: She sold a drum to a Brodar servant in August 1104 and has only lately understood what it was for.

members.role: Son; Sled Rider
members.note: He crossed to the Velgradan shore by sled last winter on a dare and came back with a toll-fort banner.

members.role: Ratibor's wife
members.note: She was nurse to Princess Ludmila as a baby and weeps whenever her husband talks of setting her aside.

famousDead: Drove beside Vasil Brodar on the first night run to Brodava in 1035.
FX26-205.secret: The Harvest Home drum was made in the Borovik sled sheds and sold to a Brodar servant, and Bistra Borovik can name him.
hooks: Bistra is asked by the Queen's Ear where the drum came from.
Lyuba begs her husband to change his vote.
The Lake Council votes on setting the heir aside.

FX26-206.name: House Snezhin
FX26-206.title: Knight of the Ice; captain of Sled Riders
FX26-206.arms: a silver ice-staff upright on pale blue, a white star above

military.office: Captains of the Sled Riders
military.unit: a company of the Sled Riders, 300 sled-borne crossbows
military.ties: A Snezhin walks the ice ahead of the first sled team in every winter raid, ice-staff in hand, as one did on the first run to Brodava.

FX26-206.power: A knight's manor on the Brodava shore, a company of the Sled Riders, and the best ice-sense in the kingdom.
FX26-206.history: On the first night run to Brodava in November 1035, the man who walked ahead of Vasil Brodar's first team with an ice-staff, testing every step, was a fisherman named Zdenek Snezhin. He walked ahead of the sleds all winter, and Queen Ludmila knighted him in April 1036. Since then a Snezhin has walked the ice before the Sled Riders and taught the Ice Crossing: thirty paces between sleds, spiked shoes on the horses, a man with a staff in front. The family is Pavel Brodar's sworn household. On his order, a Snezhin squire bought a war-drum in Belek in August 1104.
FX26-206.reputation: Brave, quiet ice-walkers, the Prince-Consort's most loyal men.

members.role: Head of the house; Knight of the Ice
members.note: He can tell the thickness of lake ice by the sound of his staff, to a finger's width.

members.role: Heir; captain of a Sled Rider company
members.note: She worships Pavel Brodar and will not believe anything said against him.

members.role: Son; squire of the Prince-Consort
members.note: He bought the drum in Belek on his lord's order and has not slept well since Harvest Home.

members.role: Zdenek's wife
members.note: She forges the spiked horseshoes for the Sled Riders in a smithy behind the house.

famousDead: Walked ahead of the first sled team to Brodava in 1035 and was knighted in 1036.
FX26-206.secret: Bogdan Snezhin bought the Harvest Home drum on the Prince-Consort's order, and Gregor Stillwater is two questions away from him.
hooks: Bogdan wants to confess to the queen.
Mirka is ordered to find whoever is asking about the drum.
A winter raid across the ice, with a Snezhin walking first.

FX26-207.name: House Kitobov
FX26-207.title: Knight of the Whaling Stations
FX26-207.arms: a white whale on slate grey, a red harpoon above

military.office: Captains of the Dobin harbor gate
military.unit: a company of the Dobin garrison, 200 crossbows at the harbor gate and the whaling stations
military.ties: Kitobov crossbows held the Dobin harbor gate against the giants in 1097, and the family still keeps the gate's keys.

FX26-207.power: Twelve whaling boats, the whaling station at Torvik Point, and the keys of the Dobin harbor gate.
FX26-207.history: The Kitobovs came north with Stepan Kolin's burned-out families in 1064 and learned whaling at Dobin. Lord Ivo Kolin knighted Sergei Kitobov in 1096 for killing a giant on the Torholm shore with a whaling harpoon. In August 1097, when thirty giants broke Dobin's harbor gate, it was Sergei who shut it with thirty townsfolk still outside; eleven of them died, and Dobin has not forgiven him. In October 1104 two Kitobov boats struck a Frost Leviathan off the Torvik capes, against the Truce of Dobin, and lost it when it drifted north. Lord Kolin paid the crews to keep quiet.
FX26-207.reputation: Tough, hard-drinking whalers with a door that some in Dobin will never forgive.

members.role: Head of the house; Knight of the Whaling Stations
members.note: He shut the harbor gate on eleven of his neighbors in 1097 and would do it again, and he says so.

members.role: Heir; harpooner
members.note: Her harpoon was the first into the Frost Leviathan in October, and she wants to sail north and find the body.

members.role: Son; boat captain
members.note: He captained the second boat that day and has not been paid enough to forget the whale's eye.

members.role: Sergei's wife
members.note: She feeds the widows of the eleven who died outside the gate, without her husband's leave.

FX26-207.secret: The Frost Leviathan struck in October 1104 carries Kitobov harpoons, and the giants of Hrimfell may already have found it.
hooks: A giant envoy arrives at Dobin with a Drevnan harpoon head.
Vesela sails north to find the whale before anyone else does.
The kin of the eleven dead finally take their revenge on Sergei.

FX26-208.name: House Polyanin
FX26-208.title: Lord of the Zorek Hills
FX26-208.arms: a black sword point-down on steppe yellow, between two green hills

military.office: Wardens of the Zorek field
military.unit: the Zorek march foot, 600 spears and crossbows
military.ties: The Polyanins hold the hills where the princes fell in 1064, and every Polyanin son swears at the Zorek cairn to stand where his grandfather ran.

FX26-208.power: Hill farms around Zorek, the field where the Battle of Zorek was fought, and a warden's place on the Steppe March.
FX26-208.history: Lord Danilo Polyanin's father died at Zorek in May 1064, in the charge that broke when the orc drums sounded and both princes fell. In 1066, after the Treaty of Thardush, the Zoracs gave his family the hills of the battlefield to hold. The Polyanins keep the Zorek cairn where the princes died and are the loudest voices of the Rye Shame, the party that calls the rye tribute a disgrace. They back Vadim Zorac's holding of the rye at Sevmir. They do not know that he ran at Zorek, and that his father's men wrote him into the list of the last stand.
FX26-208.reputation: Hot-blooded steppe lords who would rather fight the orcs than feed them.

members.role: Head of the house; Baron of the Zorek Hills
members.note: He keeps the Zorek cairn and tells every guest that Vadim Zorac stood with his father to the end.

members.role: His wife
members.note: Her own father was in the rout of 1064 and told her who ran; she has never told her husband.

members.role: Heir; captain of the Zorek foot
members.note: He wants to ride out against the Whitehorn riders on the grazing line before spring.

members.role: Daughter
members.note: She has made friends with a half-orc herd-girl and has learned some of the Tusk speech.

famousDead: Died at Zorek in the charge that broke under the drums.
FX26-208.secret: Lady Stoyana knows from her own father that Vadim Zorac ran at Zorek, and her husband has staked the house's honor on the Lord Marshal's.
hooks: Radim rides against the Whitehorn riders and starts the war his house wants.
Stoyana tells her husband the truth about Zorek.
Liliya's herd-girl brings word that the Tusk riders are gathering.

FX26-209.name: House Ostrovin
FX26-209.title: Lord Advocate of the Monastery Isles
FX26-209.arms: a brown oak growing from a blue island, on white

military.office: Protectors of the Monastery Isles
military.unit: the island guard, 150 boat-spears of the Dromir boat-spears
military.ties: Ostrovin boat-spears guard the island monasteries of the Crown Lakes, and the house's sons serve a year in the boat sheds before they take their seat.

FX26-209.power: The lay advocacy of the island monasteries of the Crown Lakes, a share of their forest rents, and the ear of the lesser Patriarch.
FX26-209.history: By 900 the island monasteries of the Crown Lakes owned a fifth of the land around them and needed a lord to judge their tenants and guard their islands. In 912 King Svetozar II made the Ostrovins their lay advocates. The house has stood between the monks and the world since, and it stands now with Stefan the Grey, the lesser Patriarch of Drevna, who wants a Drevnan church free of the Patriarch of Dawn at Velgrad. The Ostrovins never forgave Patriarch Kirill for crowning Queen Milena himself in 1085. Their head knows that a copyist of the lesser Patriarch's house added the set-aside clause to Ludmila's Code in 1066, because his own grandfather paid him.
FX26-209.reputation: Pious, wealthy island lords who speak for the monks and for themselves.

members.role: Head of the house; Lord Advocate of the Monastery Isles
members.note: He has his grandfather's ledger showing a payment to a copyist in September 1066, and he has told Stefan the Grey.

members.role: Heir
members.note: She is friends with Miron Velic, the keeper of the law rolls, and suspects what he is hiding.

members.role: Son; monk of the Isle of Hives
members.note: He took his vows at twenty and keeps the island's bees.

members.role: Grandmother
members.note: She remembers the crowning of 1085 and turns her back whenever a Velgradan priest enters a church.

famousDead: Paid a copyist of the lesser Patriarch's house to add the set-aside clause in 1066, at King Yaromir's private wish.
FX26-209.secret: The Ostrovins paid the copyist who forged the set-aside clause in 1066, at King Yaromir's private wish, and their ledger proves it.
hooks: Stefan the Grey asks the Ostrovins to keep the ledger hidden.
Bogdana and Miron Velic compare notes.
Pavel Brodar learns the clause is forged and wants the ledger burned.

FX26-210.name: House Zhitnik
FX26-210.title: Knight of the Rye Barns
FX26-210.arms: three gold ears of rye on brown
FX26-210.power: The crown's rye barns at Polgrad, a knight's manor, and the duty of gathering the 2,000 bushels owed each winter at Thardush.
FX26-210.history: When the Treaty of Thardush was signed in 1066, someone had to gather 2,000 bushels of rye each winter and cart it to the grazing line, and in 1067 King Yaromir knighted Anton Zhitnik, the grain-reeve of Polgrad, for the task. The Zhitniks have filled the rye carts every winter since and have watched the Tusk riders take them. They know the rye is cheaper than war; Polgrad's granaries burned in 1065, and they rebuilt them. In December 1104 Lord Marshal Zorac held the rye at Sevmir, and the Zhitniks have offered the queen a second load from their own barns.
FX26-210.reputation: Practical grain-reeves the Rye Shame calls orc-feeders and the Silk Peace calls patriots.

members.role: Head of the house; Knight of the Rye Barns
members.note: He has driven the rye carts to Thardush himself nineteen times and has eaten mutton with the War-Mother's envoys.

members.role: Heir
members.note: She wants to drive a second load of rye to Thardush herself, without the Lord Marshal's leave.

members.role: Son; carter-captain
members.note: He has driven the rye road this winter and says there was no danger on it.

members.role: Anton's wife
members.note: She fears that driving rye past the Lord Marshal will cost her family its knighthood.

famousDead: Grain-reeve of Polgrad, knighted in 1067 to gather the Thardush rye.
FX26-210.secret: The Zhitniks have already loaded a second rye train in their Polgrad barns, ready to drive east the moment the queen nods, or perhaps before.
hooks: Hristina drives the rye east without leave.
Rye Shame men try to burn the Zhitnik barns.
The Tusk envoy asks for the Zhitniks by name.

FX26-211.name: the Ugavins
FX26-211.title: Castellan of Ugava Fort
FX26-211.arms: a grey stone fort with a black wagon wall before it, on yellow

military.office: Hereditary castellans of Ugava Fort on the Steppe March
military.unit: Ugava Fort and the wagon forts of the Steppe March, 1,200 garrison crossbows and spears
military.ties: The Ugavins teach the wagon-fort drill to every new company of the Steppe March and have held Ugava against riders since the Tusk War.

FX26-211.power: Ugava Fort on the steppe edge, its wagon forts and stores, and the trust of the Lord Marshal.
FX26-211.history: In the spring of 1063, while 5,000 orcs besieged Zorin, a Zorac captain named Bojan Ugavin held the half-built fort at Ugava with 300 crossbows behind a ring of farm wagons for eleven days. The Zoracs made it a stone fort after the war and gave it to his line. The Ugavins keep the wagon-fort drill: wagons chained wheel to wheel, crossbows between them, spearmen under the beds. They have watched the grazing line for forty years, and in 1105 they watch 5,000 riders gather on it. The castellan holds the Lord Marshal's orders and doubts them.
FX26-211.reputation: Steady, careful frontier soldiers; when the Ugavins worry, the march worries.

members.role: Head of the house; Castellan of Ugava Fort
members.note: He has told the Lord Marshal in writing that the rye roads are safe, and kept a copy of the letter.

members.role: Heir; captain of the wagon forts
members.note: She can chain forty wagons into a fort in the time it takes a rider to cross the line.

members.role: Son; scout of the Still Watch
members.note: He lies in the grass by the grazing line for days and counts the riders' fires.

members.role: Bojan's wife
members.note: She keeps two winters' food in the fort's cellars and never says why.

famousDead: Held the half-built fort at Ugava behind farm wagons for eleven days in 1063.
FX26-211.secret: Castellan Bojan has written to the Lord Marshal that the rye roads are safe, and has kept a copy that would prove Vadim Zorac's excuse is false.
hooks: Gavril counts more fires on the grazing line than there were yesterday.
The Lord Marshal asks Bojan to burn his copy.
Tusk riders test the wagon forts in the spring thaw.

FX26-212.name: the Tverdoslavs
FX26-212.title: Castellan of Tversk Fort
FX26-212.arms: a white tower on dark blue, three white wavy lines below

military.office: Hereditary castellans of Tversk Fort and the Western Lakes posts
military.unit: Tversk Fort and the western lake posts, 1,800 garrison crossbows
military.ties: The Tverdoslavs keep the posts of the Western Lakes that watch the Velgradan shore, and they train the crossbows that man them.

FX26-212.power: Tversk Fort on the Western Lakes, its lake posts, and the ice road the kingdom's armies use in winter.
FX26-212.history: After the Peace of Polov fixed the border in 1037, Queen Ludmila built Tversk Fort on the Western Lakes and gave it to a crossbow captain named Yaroslav Tverdoslav, whose company had shot from Brodava's walls beside the town's women. His family has kept it since, and it keeps the ice road that the kingdom's sled armies cross in winter. The Tverdoslavs have fought no war in seventy years and drilled for one every winter. In 1105 the castellan's heir wants to strike back for the Velgradan weir raids, and the castellan wants nothing to break the peace before the Greyhaven match.
FX26-212.reputation: Disciplined, unshowy border soldiers who keep the queen's peace in the west.

members.role: Head of the house; Castellan of Tversk Fort
members.note: He has kept the western peace for thirty years and means to keep it one more.

members.role: Heir; captain of the lake posts
members.note: She wants to cross the ice and hang the Velgradan weir raiders from their own kremlin gate.

members.role: Son; master of the ice road
members.note: He stakes the ice road across the lakes every winter and knows where it would fail under an army.

members.role: Yaroslav's wife
members.note: She keeps a guest-hall for travelers on the ice road and hears all the Velgradan news first.

famousDead: Shot from Brodava's walls in 1035 and became the first castellan of Tversk in 1037.
FX26-212.secret: Ivo Tverdoslav knows a stretch of the ice road that would break under a heavy army, and has told only the queen's listeners, so that it can be used against an invader.
hooks: Dobroslava crosses the ice for revenge.
A Velgradan envoy comes over the ice road asking for the castellan.
Ivo's weak ice is needed, or found, by the wrong side.

FX26-213.name: the Dobniks
FX26-213.title: Warden of Dobnik Fort and the Salt Road
FX26-213.arms: a grey mountain with a white salt-road climbing it, on brown

military.office: Wardens of Dobnik Fort and the Southern Hills watch
military.unit: Dobnik Fort and the caravan-road guards, 800 scouts and archers of the Southern Hills watch
military.ties: Dobnik scouts watch the passes of the Southern Hills toward the Roof and the steppe, and their archers guard the salt caravans down from Eaglespire.

FX26-213.power: The mountain fort of Dobnik, the salt-road toll post below it, and the friendship of the Skyhold caravan masters.
FX26-213.history: When Drevnan merchants sealed the Salt Letters of Eaglespire with Skyhold in 1071, the yak caravans began coming down each summer with salt, borax and sky wool, and the crown built Dobnik Fort to guard their road. Its first warden, Kazimir Dobnik, had fought at Zorek and wanted a post far from drums. His family has kept the fort since, guarding the salt road and watching the passes of the Southern Hills for raiders. They speak a little of the Skyfolk tongue and trade butter tea recipes with the caravan masters. In 1105 the warden's son is missing on the high road, where he went to look for an old caravan path.
FX26-213.reputation: Quiet mountain wardens, good hosts, better scouts.

members.role: Head of the house; Warden of Dobnik Fort
members.note: He was in the rout at Zorek at eighteen and still cannot bear the sound of a drum.

members.role: Heir; captain of the caravan guards
members.note: She escorts the salt caravans to Eaglespire and back and has never lost a yak.

members.role: Son; missing in the hills
members.note: He went up the high road in October looking for an old caravan path over the Roof and has not come back.

members.role: Kazimir's wife; a Skyfolk woman
members.note: She came down from the Roof with a caravan in 1078 and stayed; the lowland fevers nearly killed her twice.

FX26-213.secret: Kazimir Dobnik ran at Zorek beside the young Vadim Zorac and saw him run first, and he took the mountain post to be far from anyone who might ask.
hooks: Neda goes up the high road to find her brother.
A Skyhold caravan arrives with news of a lowlander in a monastery.
The Lord Marshal sends for the man who saw him run.

FX26-214.name: House Strazhnik
FX26-214.title: Castellan of Lubevo Kremlin
FX26-214.arms: a gold key upright on dark green, a black chain around it

military.office: Hereditary castellans of Lubevo Kremlin and the Middle Dromir garrisons
military.unit: Lubevo Kremlin and the Middle Dromir river garrisons, 1,600 garrison troops
military.ties: The Strazhniks guard the river road and the silk granaries of the Middle Dromir, and their garrisons escort the treasury's silver from the staple to the Listening Tower.

FX26-214.power: Lubevo Kremlin in the forest above the Dromir, the river garrisons, and the keys of the strongroom where the crown's silk silver rests.
FX26-214.history: After Tusk riders burned Polgrad's granaries in 1065, King Yaromir built Lubevo Kremlin in the forest above the Dromir to guard the river road and the silk silver, and in 1066 he gave it to Ivan Strazhnik, a captain of the Lubany garrison. The Strazhniks keep the kremlin's strongroom, where the treasury's silk toll rests between Lubany and Drevna. House Lubec, which runs the treasury, trusts them with everything. Among the chests in the strongroom are some that hold the toll silver of Gurz the Toll-Keeper of Kraoth, which the Lubecs keep on deposit for the orc and have partly lent to the crown.
FX26-214.reputation: Close-mouthed, reliable castellans; the treasury's watchdogs.

members.role: Head of the house; Castellan of Lubevo Kremlin
members.note: He counts the strongroom chests every night and knows that some of them belong to an orc.

members.role: Heir; captain of the river escort
members.note: She escorts the silver barges down the Dromir and has twice beaten off river pirates.

members.role: Son; keeper of the strongroom keys
members.note: He has borrowed from the orc's chests to pay his gambling debts and means to put it back by spring.

members.role: Ivan's wife
members.note: She keeps the kremlin's garden and feeds the river garrison's widows.

famousDead: Captain of the Lubany garrison; first castellan of Lubevo Kremlin in 1066.
FX26-214.secret: Fedor Strazhnik has taken silver from the chests of Gurz the Toll-Keeper to pay his debts, and the orc will ask for his deposit if war comes.
hooks: Gurz the Toll-Keeper sends for his silver.
The river pirate learns what the strongroom holds.
Darya finds her brother's dice debts written in an orc's tally.

FX26-215.name: the Samostrel women
FX26-215.sur: son or daughter of the mother; called Samostrel by byname
FX26-215.title: Bolt-Sergeant of the Zorin Crossbows
FX26-215.arms: a sign: a black crossbow bolt on yellow, cut into the stock of every family crossbow
FX26-215.words: From the Wall, From the Wagon

military.office: Hereditary sergeants of the Zorin Crossbows
military.unit: the Zorin Crossbows, 3,000 crossbows at Zorin and Sevmir
military.ties: Since Queen Ludmila let the women of Brodava keep their crossbows, a Samostrel woman has been a sergeant of the Zorin Crossbows, and Mara Zorac learned her loading drill from one.

FX26-215.power: Sergeants' places in the Zorin Crossbows, a free farm near Zorek, and the right granted in 1038 to keep and bear the crossbow.
FX26-215.history: Zdenka Samostrel shot a crossbow from the walls of Brodava through the winter of 1035, and on New Year's Day 1038 Queen Ludmila freed her family from bondage and let her keep her weapon. Her daughters went south to the Steppe March, and the Samostrels have been sergeants of the Zorin Crossbows ever since, a line in which mothers pass the crossbow and the sergeant's cord to daughters. Their children carry their mother's name. Three Samostrels shot from the walls of Zorin in the siege of 1063. The present sergeant guarded the rye carts in December 1104 beside Mara Zorac and knows the roads were safe.
FX26-215.reputation: The best crossbow shots in the kingdom, and the most stubborn women on the Steppe March.

members.role: Head of the family; Bolt-Sergeant of the Zorin Crossbows
members.note: She guarded the rye carts in December and will swear before the Lake Council that the roads were safe, if anyone asks her.

members.role: Heir; file-leader of the Zorin Crossbows
members.note: She outshot the Lord Marshal's own nephew at the yard and was given extra watches for it.

members.role: Son; bolt-maker
members.note: He makes the family's bolts and is the first Samostrel man to want the sergeant's cord.

members.role: Grandmother
members.note: She shot from the walls of Zorin in 1063 and still sleeps with her grandmother's crossbow.

famousDead: Shot from Brodava's walls in 1035 and was freed with her crossbow in 1038.
FX26-215.secret: Sergeant Vlasta carried Mara Zorac's private letter about the safe rye roads to House Lubec herself.
hooks: The Lake Council summons a crossbow sergeant to speak about the roads.
Tomas asks his grandmother for the sergeant's cord.
The Lord Marshal's men ask who carried Mara's letter.

FX26-216.name: the Tikhomirs
FX26-216.sur: son or daughter of the father; the Tikhomirs, 'quiet peace', by byname
FX26-216.title: Sergeant of the Listener's Guard
FX26-216.arms: a sign: a white open hand with a finger to the lips, on green

military.office: Sergeants of the Listener's Guard and the Still Watch
military.unit: the Listener's Guard, 400 men of the Listening Tower, and the Still Watch
military.ties: Since Ludmila founded the Listener's Guard in 1048, Tikhomirs have taught its hand-signs and stood sergeant at the queen's door with wax in their ears.

FX26-216.power: Sergeants' places in the Listener's Guard, a house on the Tower Isle, and the hand-sign tongue of the Still Hall.
FX26-216.history: Mila Tikhomir was a deaf boatman's daughter who spoke with her hands, and in 1048, when Queen Ludmila founded the Listener's Guard to fight with wax in their ears, she taught them her family's signs. The Tikhomirs have taught the signs and stood sergeant in the Guard ever since. They serve Gregor Stillwater, the Guard's captain, and trained under Lev Hollis in the Still Hall. In 1105 the Guard hunts the drummer of Harvest Home. The sergeant's daughter has noticed that Lev Hollis no longer sees well at night, and the sergeant's son has noticed a Snezhin squire who goes pale when drums are mentioned.
FX26-216.reputation: Silent, watchful, utterly loyal guardsmen of the Tower.

members.role: Head of the family; Sergeant of the Listener's Guard
members.note: He has stood at the queen's door for twenty years and has never once heard what was said behind it.

members.role: Daughter; Still Watch scout
members.note: She has seen Lev Hollis miss a man in the dark that she saw plainly, and has told no one.

members.role: Son; guardsman
members.note: He has noticed a Snezhin squire who goes white whenever drums are mentioned.

members.role: Grandmother; deaf
members.note: She is the last of the family who was born deaf, and her hand-jokes make the whole Guard laugh in silence.

famousDead: Taught the Listener's Guard her family's hand-signs in 1048.
FX26-216.secret: Oleg Tikhomir suspects the Snezhin squire who bought the drum, and Tihana knows the Still Hall's master is losing his night sight.
hooks: Oleg follows the pale squire to the Brodar sled house.
Tihana must decide whether to tell Gregor Stillwater about Lev Hollis's eyes.
A drum sounds on the lake at night and the Guard turn out.

FX26-217.name: the Svechin wax house
FX26-217.title: Master of the Svechin Wax House
FX26-217.arms: a gold star over a white candle, on deep red
FX26-217.power: The largest stall in the Wax Market, candle shops in four river towns, the island monasteries' candle trade, and a hand in buying furs and wax for export.
FX26-217.history: The Svechins have made and sold candles at Drevna since 951, when the island monasteries first ordered beeswax lights for the Dawn Liturgy by the thousand. They buy wax from the Pchelin hives and the free beekeepers, sell candles to the monasteries and the Wax Market, and send fur and wax down the Dromir and across the Tolek. When Velgrad threatened the Tolek in 1100, the Svechins lost their Koritsa trade. Their master pays the Rivermen's Guild's dues and knows exactly what part of those dues pays a river pirate to rob Velgradan barges. The house's younger son is a pelt-buyer in the Wax Market who pays thieves a quarter and asks nothing.
FX26-217.reputation: Rich, devout and careful merchants; the monasteries' candle-makers.

members.role: Head of the house; Master of the Wax House
members.note: He lights a candle on the island every dawn for the Velgradan barges his dues help sink.

members.role: Heir; mistress of the candle shops
members.note: She has opened a candle shop in Greyhaven's Galley Strand in hope of the royal marriage.

members.role: Younger son; pelt-buyer of the Wax Market
members.note: He has a bale of Velgradan sables with the toll seals still on them and needs it out of the city.

members.role: Gavril's wife
members.note: She embroiders altar cloths for the lesser Patriarch and passes on what his priests say.

famousDead: Won the first great candle order from the island monasteries in 951.
FX26-217.secret: Lev Svechin fences stolen Velgradan sables in the Wax Market, and one of his bales came off a barge robbed by the Rivermen's Guild's pirate.
hooks: Gregor Stillwater asks Lev about a bale with toll seals.
Olga's Greyhaven shop needs a royal wedding that may never happen.
